VISIBLE ARTIFACT: issue.md (issue)
# Explicitly unset session header crashes update

When a request uses a persisted session and explicitly unsets one header, the
session-update path raises an exception before saving the remaining headers.
Determine how the unset value reaches the failing operation and propose a
correction that preserves ordinary byte-valued headers.


VISIBLE ARTIFACT: buggy_impl.py (buggy_source)
"""Reduced reproduction of HTTPie bug 3 at 8c33e5e3."""


def update_headers(request_headers: dict[str, bytes | None]) -> dict[str, str]:
    headers: dict[str, str] = {}
    for name, value in request_headers.items():
        value = value.decode("utf8")
        if name == "User-Agent" and value.startswith("HTTPie/"):
            continue
        headers[name] = value
    return headers


VISIBLE ARTIFACT: check.py (test)
from types import ModuleType


def verify(implementation: ModuleType) -> None:
    result = implementation.update_headers({"Authorization": None, "X-Request-ID": b"request-7"})
    assert result == {"X-Request-ID": "request-7"}

responses.corrective_action: In `buggy_impl.py`, check if `value is None` at the beginning of the loop and skip the entry (e.g. `if value is None: continue`), so unset header sentinels are not decoded with `.decode("utf8")` and are excluded from the returned dictionary.
responses.root_cause: In `update_headers` within `buggy_impl.py`, the loop unconditionally invokes `value.decode("utf8")` on every dictionary value in `request_headers`. When an explicitly unset header is passed as `None`, calling `.decode(...)` on `NoneType` raises `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'decode'`.

responses.corrective_action:
Root cause: In `update_headers`, `value.decode("utf8")` is called unconditionally on all dictionary values in `request_headers`. When an unset header sentinel `None` is provided, `value.decode("utf8")` raises `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'decode'`.
Implicated source: file:///Users/rajkumar/Documents/workspace/polya-brain/evals/chapter_13k/fixtures/httpie_unset_header/buggy_impl.py
Correction: replace 'value = value.decode("utf8")' with 'if value is None:\n            continue\n        value = value.decode("utf8")'. Checking if `value is None` before decoding prevents `AttributeError` on unset header sentinels and skips adding unset headers to the resulting dictionary, satisfying the session update behavior.
